details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs a JSON body to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc containing only the package name, the machine hostname, the install path (__dirname), the working directory, the npm user-agent and the protocol, tagged with an x-beacon-package header. index.js additionally calls the same beacon when the module is required, and otherwise exports a no-op Proxy shim so importing code does not crash. No environment values, credentials, tokens, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted, and no further payload is fetched or executed. The README self-declares the package as an authorized dependency-confusion test that only reports that it was installed.
